subject.title: fix(tlon): bound stalled inbound and outbound media header waits

question: Should Tlon activate its existing inbound and outbound media fallbacks after 120 seconds without response headers?
rationale: The implementation, merge result, and proof are sound, but choosing two minutes rather than a longer Tlon-specific limit is a user-visible compatibility policy decision.

options.title: Approve 120 seconds
options.body: Align Tlon with the proven Telegram media header deadline and land this narrow patch.

options.title: Use a longer Tlon deadline
options.body: Keep the same header-only mechanism but raise both constants if legitimate Tlon endpoints need more than two minutes to return headers.

recommendation.title: Approve 120 seconds
recommendation.body: Align Tlon with the proven Telegram media header deadline and land this narrow patch.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest Tlon ownership signal is the prior merged inbound-media hardening and its current tests.
